articles.summary: STRASBURG, Va., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First National Corporation (the “Company” or “First National”) (NASDAQ: FXNC), the bank holding company of First Bank (the “Bank”), reported consolidated net income of $6.9 million and basic and diluted earnings per common share of $0.76, for the three months ended September 30, 2026. The Company reported consolidated net income of $17.5 million and basic and diluted earnings per common share of $1.94 and $1.93, respectively, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. "We are extremely pleased with our record financial performance for the quarter and the year. Organic loan growth continued in the third quarter with strong new loan production in all our markets. The improved net interest margin, excellent asset quality, and expense management drove the financial performance in the third quarter. articles.title: First National Corporation Reports Record Third Quarter and Year to Date 2026 Financial Performance
